# Linger (余音)

> Linger is a native macOS 14+ desktop lyrics companion built in Swift 6 and Metal. It displays floating, word-by-word synced lyrics with album-inspired aurora backgrounds, bilingual translations, click-through locking, and XDR HDR glow alongside Apple Music, Spotify, and NetEase Cloud Music. Includes a full-featured 14-day free trial (no credit card required), followed by a $4.99 USD one-time lifetime license for up to 3 Macs with 14-day instant self-service refunds.

- Current Version: 1.0.2 (Universal Binary for Apple silicon & Intel, Apple Notarized)
- Platform: macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later
- Pricing: 14-day full-featured free trial, then $4.99 USD one-time purchase (up to 3 Macs, no subscription, free updates)
- Support: support@levicraft.app
